items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Tommy and Daddy, that was from 8 to 4 in the morning.

ctx.x: Did that scare your husband when Walter Blue died?

No, I said he never did like it. And after Walter Blue died, Walter's voice. No, he didn't ever believe in walking a lot, like that playing parades. And them days was different. After, of course, like now the union's behind those fellas. But them days, you had to go and play with a man. He wants to go out this way because he wants to pass by maybe some of his girlfriend's house. You had to make a big round and go around the other way. And you'd have to play overtime. And now they don't allow that, you see,…
